topic: Self-protection gaps left after the SP-042 review
detail: Accepted for now (best-effort target extraction, D-28; the OS sandbox is the boundary): recursive reads of a directory holding secret files (grep -r or rg over the ssh or gh profile directories, tar of them) are allowed; 'git config core.hooksPath|core.fsmonitor|core.sshCommand' is not refused (writing .git/config directly is); writes by interpreters (perl -pi, python open()) and copies that create protected files without naming them (cp -r template/.claude .) are not caught. Proposed: refuse recursive readers of those directories and those git config keys.
